title: 第1章 小师弟多了一块肉第2章 漏灵废体
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
太古神墟也称葬神墟。
传说是神明陨落之地。
天玄大陆四大禁地之首。
方圆亿万里，终年黑雾弥漫，不见天日。
距离禁地外围万里之遥，也能感觉到里面枯寂死亡的恐怖气息。
无论修士、凡人、飞禽走兽，踏入葬神墟者，十死无生，无一例外。
神陨之地，必有重宝，必有大机缘。
明知十死无生，仍有神通广大的大能、狠人，寿元将近之时，怀着赴死之心，抱一丝希望，前去葬神墟寻找机缘。
结果自然是尸骨无存，神魂俱灭。
无尽岁月里，口口相传，谈墟色变。
葬神墟逐渐成了天玄大陆的最恐怖之处，绝对的禁忌之地，无人敢涉足。
无人知晓，黑雾弥漫的葬神墟，中央核心地带却是乾坤朗朗，骄阳明媚，别有洞天。
方圆三万里的福地，宛如一颗的璀璨明珠，镶嵌在葬神墟无边无际的黑雾中。
其间，青山峻峭，似翠玉雕琢而成。
云雾流淌，缥缈宛若仙境。
汪汪碧水波光粼粼，瀑布如银练般飞泻。
小溪流水潺潺，灵雾氤氲。
溪边绿草如茵，山间古木参天。
奇花异草争奇斗艳，仙禽异兽其间嬉戏。
这一日，风和日丽。

云雾萦绕的竹屋前，比往日多了一张紫藤编织的小床。
床上躺着一个婴儿，看样子三四个月大小。
婴儿只穿着一个红色的肚兜，白白胖胖的。
似乎刚从睡梦中醒来，两只锃亮的大眼睛一闪一闪，好奇地打量眼前鸟语花香的世界。
“咦——哇——要——”
似乎发现了什么有趣的事，婴儿发出了声音。
他两只小腿乱蹬，两只小手努力支撑着身体，似乎要坐起来。
“三师姐，他就是师尊说的小师弟吧，好可爱啊。”
一个四五岁模样的小女孩听到声音跑过来。
“看，他要坐起来呢，两只眼睛真亮啊，小手小脚白白胖胖的。”
跟在后面小女孩附和道，同样四五岁光景。
俩女孩一个穿着紫裙，一个穿着绿裙，粉妆玉砌一般，可爱至极。
“三师姐，你快看，小师弟这里怎么多长了一块肉？”
紫裙女孩好奇地打量婴儿的两腿间。
“哎呀，真的多长一块肉啊，好像小鸟似的。”
绿裙女孩小女孩凑上前，眼睛睁得大大的。
content_en:
Taikoo Shenxu is also called the Burial God Ruins.
Legend has it that it is the place where gods fell.
The first of the four forbidden areas in Tianxuan Continent.
With a radius of hundreds of millions of miles, the darkness is filled with fog all year round, making it impossible to see the sky.
Thousands of miles away from the outside of the forbidden area, one can still feel the terrifying aura of silence and death inside.
No matter monks, mortals, birds or animals, anyone who steps into the God Burial Ruins will die without any exception.
In the place where the gods fell, there must be important treasures and great opportunities.
Knowing that there is no life after death, there are still powerful and ruthless people with great supernatural powers. When his life is approaching, with the intention of dying and a glimmer of hope, he goes to the Burial God Ruins to look for opportunities.
The result is naturally that there are no bones left and all the souls are destroyed.
For endless years, word of mouth has passed down the story, and the story has changed.
The Burial God Ruins has gradually become the most terrifying place in Tianxuan Continent, an absolutely taboo place where no one dares to set foot.
No one knows that in the dark mist-filled God Burial Ruins, the central core area is bright and clear, the sun is shining brightly, and there is a unique cave.
The blessed land with a radius of thirty thousand miles is like a bright pearl embedded in the endless black mist of the Burial God Ruins.
In the meantime, the green mountains are steep and steep, as if carved from jade.
The clouds and mist flow, misty like a fairyland.
The clear water is sparkling, and the waterfalls are like silver.
The small stream is gurgling and the spiritual mist is thick.
There are green grass beside the stream and towering ancient trees in the mountains.
Exotic flowers and plants compete for beauty, and fairies and animals play among them.
On this day, the wind was calm and the sun was beautiful.
In front of the bamboo house surrounded by clouds and mist, there is an extra small bed woven with wisteria than before.
There was a baby lying on the bed, apparently three or four months old.
The baby only wore a red bellyband and was white and fat.
As if he had just woken up from his sleep, his two big bright eyes flickered, curiously looking at the world in front of him with the singing of birds and the fragrance of flowers.
"Eh-wha-gonna-"
Seemingly discovering something interesting, the baby made a sound.
He kicked his calves wildly, and tried hard to support his body with his two small hands, as if he wanted to sit up.
"Third Senior Sister, he is the little Junior Brother that Master mentioned. He is so cute."
A little girl who looked like four or five years old ran over when she heard the sound.
"Look, he's about to sit up. His eyes are so bright, and his little hands and feet are white and plump."
The little girl following behind echoed, also about four or five years old.
One of the two girls was wearing a purple skirt and the other was wearing a green skirt. Their pink makeup looked like jade and they were extremely cute.
"Third Senior Sister, look, little Junior Brother, why is there an extra piece of flesh here?"
The girl in the purple skirt looked curiously between the baby's legs.
"Oh, you really have a lot of flesh, like a little bird."
The little girl in the green dress stepped forward, her eyes wide open.
